jump_param.special_desc:
Elisa, a half-human, half-vampire girl, believes the Lockhart triplets are the only people in the world she can truly trust. She wants to become human for them—and spend forever with one of them.

But everything changes when Amber, the maid’s daughter, appears. Again and again, Elisa is abandoned, humiliated, and stripped of her dignity. All for Amber. Finally, she decides to let go and accept her fate: leaving day school behind, transferring to night school, and becoming a vampire.

But when Elisa appears in her night school uniform, held in the arms of a powerful vampire heir, why do the triplets who once threw her away suddenly fall into regret and panic—kneeling before her, begging for forgiveness?

Based on the Wattpad novel by Emily Jean. Determined to lose her virginity before she starts college, Farrah Blake strikes a deal with her best friend and crush since forever, the billionaire heir Ethan Sinclair, who will find the perfect guy for her first time, or take her v-card himself.

banners.title: 高清The Alpha and His Nanny Luna

jump_param.book_title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna
jump_param.special_desc: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but her newborn daughter vanished without a trace. Desperate to find her, Tiffany takes a job as a nanny at the Silvermoon Pack, never realizing the little princess in her care is her own missing daughter. The girl's father is Asher Sterling—the ruthless, untouchable Alpha who has spent five years searching for the mysterious woman from his one unforgettable night. As Tiffany and Asher are drawn together, old enemies resurface, deadly secrets unravel...

banners.title: 高清Dear Brother, Your Regret Came Too Late

jump_param.book_title: Dear Brother, Your Regret Came Too Late
jump_param.special_desc: For sixteen years, Stephanie has lived with a guilt she never deserved — her mother died giving birth to her. Neglected by her father, Morris, and despised by her brother, Alexander — she clings to the only warmth Alexander ever gave her. But when their cousin Abigail moves in, even Alexander turns on her, wishing she were the one who had died. And in a way, he gets his wish when Stephanie is diagnosed with cancer. But after her death, it's Alexander's world that begins to fall apart.

banners.title: 高清The Great and Powerful Genie

jump_param.special_desc: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.

Malik Carter grew up dirt poor, training on a cracked outdoor court while his single mother worked three jobs to keep him fed—until an NBA scout secretly makes him the number one draft pick. But a month of sealed pre-draft testing leaves him unreachable, and his hometown decides the worst: that he's been arrested for prostitution. His own uncle, aunt, and cousin turn the whole church against him and his mother, stripping them of dignity, stealing from them, and even scalding her hand to punish his "lies." When the truth finally breaks, every person who spat on his family scrambles to grovel—but Malik's fight isn't over. At his own rookie celebration, the father who abandoned his pregnant mother years ago shows up flaunting a new wife and a stepson chasing the same spotlight. As the draft countdown hits zero, everyone who ever doubted, humiliated, or betrayed Malik and his mother is about to learn exactly who they were dealing with.

banners.title: 高清Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village

jump_param.book_title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
jump_param.special_desc: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.

banners.title: 高清Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with

jump_param.book_title: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with
jump_param.special_desc: After three years of hidden trial in a homeless camp, Vince Astor is crowned America's Godfather, heir to $20.9 billion. He keeps the secret when Helen Stark, the CEO he saved two years ago, proposes to him on the street. Still dressed as a bum, he follows her home and swallows her family's scorn as they force her to marry Philip West. His power then surfaces layer by layer. A bank president kneels, a $1 billion bid lands, an underboss kisses his ring. Helen chooses him anyway, for who he is.
